title: Define the Principal seam and the waitlist-safe route marker
description:
**Phase 1 of 7.** Keep it small and merge it within a day: three phase-3 tasks fork from it and must agree on the shape first.

- **Blocked by:** nothing, start today
- **Runs in parallel with:** 79ca6a, 7c1382, 0ab02c, 272aea
- **Unblocks:** 5f0c4c, fac2ee, 79578e

---
Principal is a frozen dataclass with a kind (user or worker), tenant_id, and either user_id with membership status and role, or worker_id. Add the FastAPI dependency that will resolve it and the explicit marker that declares a route reachable by a waitlisted member. No resolver implementations and no enforcement in this task.

Routing is default deny by construction: a route serves an enabled member unless it is explicitly marked otherwise. Do not build a denylist of expensive routes. The next route someone adds would be open by default, and one day that route is the one that calls the model.

**Done when:** the type and the marker are merged so the three dependent tasks can proceed in parallel.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
**Architect ruling: the exact shape, so the three dependent tasks can fork.**

```python
class PrincipalKind(StrEnum):
    USER = "user"
    WORKER = "worker"

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Principal:
    kind: PrincipalKind
    tenant_id: str
    user_id: str | None = None
    worker_id: str | None = None
    membership_status: MembershipStatus | None = None
    role: Role | None = None
```

**Two kinds, and only two.** Do not add a system, service, or test kind. A test-only principal is a second authentication path, and the repository does not keep two; our own tooling authenticates as a worker (see d71ed5).

**The marker is opt-out, not opt-in.** The dependency requires an enabled member by default. A route reachable by a waitlisted member says so explicitly. As of today exactly one route is waitlist-safe: `GET /me`. `/health` and the authentication routes take no principal at all and are not part of the marker system.

**Not in this task:** resolvers, JWT verification, worker credentials, enforcement. Land the type and the marker, nothing else. Three tasks are waiting on the shape rather than the behavior.
